title: Chicken jockey game+
body:
This modpack tries to make minecraft feel _new_ again!

![Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba9ccdf02a2ce11e1f7cc4255d59c9c88b0c889b.jpeg)

Some of the mods and resource packs used:
1. [Hold My Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/hold-my-items) by [Tree Corp](https://modrinth.com/organization/team-tree),
2. [HT's TreeChop](https://modrinth.com/mod/treechop) by [hammertater](https://modrinth.com/user/hammertater),
3. [Stay True](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/stay-true) by [haimcyfly](https://www.curseforge.com/members/haimcyfly/projects) 

I used photon shaders in screenshots btw
